Results.ReviewText: I am really looking forward to using this grill. I've been using an offset Brinkman for years. But with the kids moved out it's too big for just the wife and I. Too cold lately to fire the new Weber up, but spring will get here soon, I hope!
Results.Title: Really like my new Weber.

Results.ReviewText: Got this grill as a Christmas gift (from me) and I love it. Arrived quickly, assembled easily and now it’s wrapped up on the back porch in the snow. I did do a burn in on day one so when it gets warmer I’m ready! Cant wait to use it
Results.Title: Looks Great!

Results.ReviewText: This is simply a remarkable product. So versitile.
Results.Title: Weber Kettle

Results.ReviewText: The quality of the product is only surpassed by the quality of the cook! First thing that was grilled came off cooked to perfection with great flavor for a grill that had not been seasoned. Very pleased.
Results.Title: Built to last - flavor is unsurpassed

Results.ReviewText: We have owned a weber charcoal for the past 35 years.  The handle broke off and cant be replaced.   It rusted through.  Love our weber bbq's!
Results.Title: Love weber charcoal BBQ

ClientResponses.Response: Your feedback is important to us.  Our Care Team will follow up with you shortly. Please look for an outreach from us soon. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Consumer Care

Results.ReviewText: These use to be very good quality grills. The first one I had bought in 2007 lasted for 8 years. Since I've own 2 of the same model with this being the 3rd in the last 10 years. The quality has diminished. Good for about 3 to 4 years if taken care of. My is covered.
Results.Title: Weber Grill

Results.ReviewText: Exactly as advertised, it’s a great grill with just the right space for our small family to grill regularly, but enough to host visitors without much trouble.
Results.Title: Perfect!

Results.ReviewText: Great grill, even during the cold January weather the grill works as intended
Results.Title: Great Grill

Results.ReviewText: Awsome kettel grill. Bought as a replacement for an older one I had.
Results.Title: Great

Results.ReviewText: As always, the quality of Weber grills are unsurpassed. The assembly was very simple and clear. This grill is as good as it gets!
Results.Title: A quality product.

Results.ReviewText: I would give it a 5 but it doesn't come with the plastic piece for the top vent. You can't touch it without burning your fingers. Now I have to modify it or buy a replacement part or just use tongs. An inexpensive part is not included on the premium kettle, and you can't buy it online!
Results.Title: Burnt Fingers

Results.ReviewText: I have been wanting to try charcoal cooking for a long time. Why not try it with a proven grill. I am so satisfied with the grill. Always learning new things and it has been fun trying new things.
Results.Title: 22" Weber kettle

Results.ReviewText:
It was a Christmas gift for my brother in law, he loves it. 
Shipped quickly, arrived in great condition thanks to the packaging.
I'm thinking we need to buy one, too.
Results.Title: Bro in law says its a great bbq

Results.ReviewText: Ive been using a pellet grill for 3 years not thrilled about the taste i got the kettle and wow what a difference it makes i wont go back im now looking to add a 22 smokey mountain
Results.Title: Best taste and flavor hands down

Photos.Caption: First cook after burning it off

Results.ReviewText: Love the premium I got mine on a sale from Lowe’s for $95. I really don’t see why Weber can’t just add the rubber piece to the vent like the master touch. Granted I understand the need to justify the upgrade but the lid cover and ability to choose multiple colors I think is enough incentive in itself to warrant the small item to prevent having to touch a hot piece of metal.
Results.Title: Good but could be great

Results.ReviewText: My first Weber kettle in 45 years.  The new ones have a lot of useful features that the old ones didn’t.  Bu the real game changer is the Weber chimney charcoal starter!
Results.Title: Back to charcoal!

Results.ReviewText: Absolutely fantastic grill. Never could figure out charcoal. Apparently it’s because I tried with a crap grill. Weber has much larger vents to give the charcoal the air it needs. Also highly recommend getting grillgrates for it.
Results.Title: Fantastic!

Results.ReviewText: Switched from a cheap Lowe’s gas grill to the Weber premium kettle.  Not sure if it’s the switch from gas to charcoal or what but my grilled food never tasted so good.  No issues with assembly or cleaning.  It’s all very straightforward.  Love this thing.  The price was great too.
Results.Title: Charcoal is king

Photos.Caption: Two 8 lb prime ribs smoking for 6 hours indirect method to perfect medium rare, hickory wood blocks on the grill over the charcoal baskets. Thermopro temp probes monitor everything.

Results.ReviewText: The original is still the best. Especially this deluxe model with the pro ash catcher. I make steaks, tri tips, Prime Rib, and even turkey in my Weber Kettle. You Tube has so many tips and tricks an videos, just search "Prime Rib Weber kettle" for instance. Recipes and more...
Results.Title: You can do anything with this barbeque!

Results.ReviewText: I finally decided to move away from my Weber gas grill for awhile and test the charcoal waters. I could'nt be happier. My new charcoal grill was easy to assemble, as I expected, and exuded the Weber brilliance when I finished. I chose the copper colored one, grabbed a cover and a chimney and I'm ready to tie on the feed bag. Thanks Weber for a fine product. I can always trust your grills and accessories.
Results.Title: The Weber Way

Results.ReviewText: Great with the rotisserie or smoking meats using the snake method
Results.Title: Love this grill

ClientResponses.Response: Thank you for your feedback. We appreciate your input on the leg assembly and want to help improve your experience. Please look for an outreach email from our Care Team soon. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Consumer Care

Results.ReviewText: This afternoon I assembled the Master Touch 22-inch kettle. My suggestion is the leg assembly needs to be redone. The clips were difficult to engage and I don't think they did on my assembly. Still, the legs seem tight. I would prefer to attach the legs with a bolt rather than the clip. I have not used the grill, but from previous experience with Weber products expect a favorable outcome.
Results.Title: Assembly

Results.ReviewText: 1st time cooking on Charcoal in over 50 years. I am learning the nuances of temperature management and having fun all the while eating very well!
Results.Title: Old dog learning new tricks

Results.ReviewText: Love this!! It’s our third Weber over the years and each one is better than the last. We grill every other week when weather permits and it always comes out perfect in our Weber!
Results.Title: Love love love

Results.ReviewText: It's a great quality grill. And I got a good deal on it. You can't beat cooking on a charcoal grill.
Results.Title: Great grill

Results.ReviewText: This grill is sweet. I love it. I'm grilling every day. Call me Chef, bouillon flame!
Results.Title: The best grill in the world!

Results.ReviewText: 22" Premium Weber Kettle is made of quality materials. However, I had an issue with the kettle itself.  it seems to be out of round and leaves gaps between the grates and the kettle. Although Weber was not able to correct this issue to my satisfaction they made one heck of a effort to do so.  They went above an beyond to try to make it right.  After a number of emails and instructions Weber provided a new kettle portion (without a lid).  The grates have much less of a gap which is terrific but now I have to disassemble and reassemble the new kettle grill I purchased.
Results.Title: Great customeer service

Results.ReviewText: I started using Weber kettles in 1981 when I received one as a house warming gift. The timeless design made better by a few improvements makes the grill an excellent and versatile device.  From a few burgers to a rib roast or turkey the Kettle can cook it all with ease.
Results.Title: Long Time Customer

Results.ReviewText: I have really enjoyed cooking on the new kettle. switched over from propane and have enjoyed the new challenge of maintaining cooking temperature. I also have really enjoyed the lite smoke flavor afforded by the charcoal grill. The one touch cleaning has been as easy as advertised which is good because that cleanup was something I was unsure about while switching from propane.
Results.Title: Ditched the gas.

Results.ReviewText: I bought this Weber grill to replace my old one that finally rusted away after 20 years with poor care. I like the features on this new one especially when it come to clean up, and a beefier charcoal grate. I've  cooked on it and it's familiar to my old one, and with great care this one will give many years of grilling.
Results.Title: Replaced my old Weber grill with a new one

Results.ReviewText: Great value, the grill does everything I need it to.
Results.Title: Great value

ClientResponses.Response:
Thank you for your feedback. We are sorry that your grill arrived damaged! That is not the quality we expect, and we apologize for the disappointment.

We stand our products and back them with a generous warranty. Your satisfaction is important to us! Please look for an email outreach from a Specialist team member. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Consumer Care

Results.ReviewText: Came in damaged seems like Weber quality is not as great as it once was
Results.Title: Quality gone down

Results.ReviewText: Some great upgrades make this even more usable than I remember. Terrific tool.
Results.Title: Nice Tool!!

Results.ReviewText: My 3rd one since the 80s. This is by far the most versatile grill you can buy. Smoking, searing, baking, etc., it can do it. There are also tons of accessories, whether made by Weber or 3rd parties. If you can only have one grill, make it this one.
Results.Title: Best grill purchase

Results.ReviewText: Purchased this to replace a standard Kettle Grill that was about 20 years old. Wanted the extras of a thermometer and the One-Touch ash catcher for easier cleanup. Was not disappointed and wish that I had purchased one sooner.
Results.Title: Great Charcoal Grill made Better

Results.ReviewText: On about my 5th Weber, all 22'' charcoal. This one is for my son, mine are basic model. Just threw away 30+ year old one that was outside by ocean, replaced grates couple times but lasted a long time. Rebuilt one I bought 12 years ago for my nephew when he bought a house - new grates and ash scraper, kettle was good as new ( well maybe a little grungy but cleanable!)
Results.Title: Charcoal 22'' kettle

ClientResponses.Response: We appreciate your feedback. So sorry to hear about your experience. We want to know more and offer our assistance. Please look for an outreach email from us soon. Thank you!

Results.ReviewText: I bought a Weber expecting better quality. On my first use, I noticed the bottom air adjustments not alleging fully with the slots in the kettle. On my second use I noticed how thin the paint/ enamel coating is when I started seeing scratches through the holes of the top air adjustment. I’m not sure if there is any difference in the quality of the hardware or paint in the Weber master touch series, but the plastic tab on the top air handler would be a nice to have.
Results.Title: It’s Okay

Results.ReviewText: Everything would have been great but they sent me a copper top and a red bottom. Smh!
Results.Title: Someone messed up big time.

14401001.Name: 22” Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill
14401001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill. This grill features a built-in lid thermometer to monitor the temperature inside the grill, and a hinged, plated-steel cooking grate flips up on either side allowing you to easily add more fuel while cooking. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retains heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Lid hook to hang lid on bowl while cooking· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant· 10-year limited warranty
